**বাংলায়:** ছবি আপলোড করলে আসলটা রেখে 5টা সাইজে AVIF, WebP আর JPEG তৈরি হয়।

## PR 590

**Product naming and URL control (owner, 19 Oct 12:04)**

**বাংলায়:** পণ্যের নাম, লিংক, SEO টাইটেল আর ব্র্যান্ড নিজে সেট করা; লিংক বদলালেও পুরনোটা কাজ করে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-20
  - Build status row: naming and links: real brand field (own label = the store's own-label brand, else the store name setting); per product name, link, SEO title and description (en/bn), feed title, brand; shop-wide templates `naming.*` with {brand} {name} {style} {type} {cat} {colour} {colours} {price} {fit} {shop}; a changed link forwards (`naming.redirectStatusCode`, default 301) with no chains, a reused link stops forwarding; every rename kept (ProductRename) with a before/after orders report (visits come with analytics, S11); "other brand" note off by default; template apply and bulk rename with preview + hash; manual old links; `/api/admin/catalogue/naming/*` (screens: PR 21)
  - GitHub pull request #12 (commit `28ea164`), 20 Oct 06:54 (Dhaka)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Product naming and URL control (owner, 19 Oct 12:04)** — owner decision (12:07, replacing 12:04): **brand names stay** — EXTAS sells those brands' products and articles name the brand; Claude's earlier warning (Merchant Center / Meta trademark policy) is recorded and the owner accepted the risk, noting ads with brand-named links already run without problems. Each product has a real **brand field** (EXTAS only for own-label), used on the page, in structured data and the feed; templates have a {brand} token. Nothing fixed in code: per product the owner sets the **name on the site, the URL slug, the SEO title, the feed/ad title and the brand (default EXTAS)**; shop-wide templates for slugs and titles; Google preview. **Changing a slug never breaks a link:** the old URL 301s to the new one automatically (also used for the WordPress migration, PR 587), so rank and sales carry over. An optional "other brand name" warning (setting, off by default); a bulk rename tool with preview; the SEO report compares organic visits and sales before/after a rename.

## PR 609

**Import from ERP by style code — shop price as the buying price, B-grade listings, price-change flag, selling-price floor (CN-028; 25 Oct …**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “পণ্য, ছবি আর ক্যাটালগ” ধাপের অংশ: পণ্য, রং, সাইজ, ক্যাটাগরি, সাইজ চার্ট আর ছবির সব কাজ।

**Details**

- **Status:** Filed (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Import from ERP by style code** (CN-028). The admin types a style code; every SKU of the style (colour, size, barcode, grade, `shopPrice`) comes in and groups into one product. The admin sees "bought from ERP at" (never shown to customers) and sets the selling price on top. A changed `shopPrice` updates the buying price and flags the admin; it never changes a selling price by itself. B-grade lines are separate listings (a switch, off by default). A **selling-price floor**: buying price + a minimum margin (a setting, empty until the owner sets it) blocks a price, coupon, combo or discount that falls below it. Launch.
- **Filed under:** [CN-028 additions — Retail and the ERP supplier model (25 Oct 2026)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#cn-028-additions--retail-and-the-erp-supplier-model-25-oct-2026)
